purpose: Teach: 苦しん/吹い/溶け/埋める/泣か/空っぽ/傷つく/嫌がる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご病気で苦しんでらしたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there was a customer who was really struggling with illness, you know.
lines.style: Soft, concerned tone. Gentle opening. Slight pause before the thought lands. Speaking as if sharing something she's been turning over in her mind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お祭りで風船を吹いてあげたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I remember you blew up balloons at the festival for people, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, almost wondering. Light upward lilt on the memory. Small smile in the voice—noticing something kind about her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、生クリーム、溶けちゃうわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the whipped cream's going to melt if you don't hurry.
lines.style: Practical but gentle. Matter-of-fact delivery with a hint of care underneath. Not nagging—just looking out for her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お庭の穴を業者さんに埋めるよう頼んだよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I asked that contractor to fill in the hole in the garden, like you wanted.
lines.style: Straightforward, steady. Small satisfaction in having handled it. Efficient but warm—the tone of someone taking care of things without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、悲しい映画でも泣かないお客様、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, even sad movies don't make that customer cry, it seems.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant. Quiet wonder at the detail. Slow pace. As if noticing something deeper than the surface fact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、冷蔵庫、もう空っぽよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the fridge is completely empty already.
lines.style: Dry, slightly exasperated but not unkind. Light wry humor in the delivery. A small sigh underneath—the tone of someone noting a problem without drama.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の心を傷つくこと、絶対避けたい、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I never want to hurt that customer's feelings, absolutely not.
lines.style: Firm but tender. Conviction underneath the gentleness. Spoken with quiet resolve—this matters to her and it shows.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、辛いお料理を嫌がるみたい、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer seems to really dislike spicy food, I've noticed.
lines.style: Soft, observant. Small reflective pause. The tone of someone who pays attention and is filing away details that matter.
